name: Musket (Adamant Entertainment)
body:
Benefit: A musket must be manually loaded with black powder, a bullet, and wadding. Loading a musket is a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity. You must use both hands to load a musket. A musket normally requires two hands to fire. You can fire a musket with one hand at a -4 penalty. You can fire a musket with each hand, but normal two-weapon fighting rules apply. This penalty is cumulative with the penalty for one-handed firing.
